environment.description: Lambda Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE (open to public internet). CloudWatch Logs subscription filter forwards logs to Elasticsearch/OpenSearch for SIEM analysis. No input sanitization on query parameters before logging. Log entries are parsed by downstream systems that interpret newline-separated JSON.

config.log_destination: CloudWatch Logs -> Subscription Filter -> OpenSearch SIEM
config.log_format: plaintext with structured JSON on stdout
config.network: public Lambda Function URL, no CloudFront or API Gateway in front
